claims.exact_statement: For every balanced Boolean sign g on every finite uniform cube, its fresh half-activation F(+1,x)=1,F(-1,x)=g(x) satisfies G(F)<=G(g)/2+1+c1 I(g), where c1=9/(8 ln 2)-1/2+1/(e ln 2); equivalently, if G(g)<=K I(g), then G(F)<=(K+2c1)I(F).
hypotheses: g is balanced under the uniform measure
z is one fresh independent physical selector
all entropy and U logarithms are in bits
proof_dependencies: Exact fresh-activation formula from B01 package commit 8344aa4aa688790494e3ebd46bb94b13f659ce18
claims.first_unproved_line: No single-use ownership telescope is proved for repeating the L1+c0 W1 charge through an arbitrary hierarchy.
